ns2:course.label: Natural Disasters
ns2:course.description: (GEOL 118) Introduces the nature, causes, risks, effects, and prediction of natural disasters including earthquakes, volcanoes, landslides,subsidence, global climate change, Severe weather, coastal erosion, floods, mass extinctions, and meteorite impacts; covers geologic principles and case histories of natural disasters as well as human responses (societal impact, mitigation strategies, and public policy). Same as ENVS 180 and GLBL 118.
